matched_title: CSV export error path throws plain Error instead of ApiError

findings.title: CSV export error path throws plain Error instead of ApiError
findings.rationale: The new `downloadFindingsCsv` helper uses a plain `fetch` and, on a non-2xx response, throws `new Error(...)`. House rule 3 requires that any client request that fails surface the server's `{ error: { code, message, details } }` body as an `ApiError`, so the page can show the status and code. The current code loses both and shows a generic message. The fix is to read the error body when it is JSON and throw `new ApiError(message, res.status, code, details)`.
